Catch waves, not worries

Cheeky Monkey is a surf and yoga camp on the main road through Midigama, close to the main point breaks.

Right alongside the guesthouse is Baba's Surf Shop. Rent a board there or buy one, and bring yours in if it needs a repair.

The spot
Close to the main point breaks, with many more surf breaks a short walk away.
The season
The best time is from October till March or April. The waves are nice and the beach is clean.

A week of surf

You pay per person for the week, and the price depends on whether you take a private room, a shared double or a shared triple. These packages and prices were published in 2021, so call to confirm them before you book.

Lessons for your level

Lessons are fitted to your level and your pace, and to your style. That goes for a total beginner and for someone chasing their next big ride.

The lesson price on this page was published in 2021. Call before you come, to check it and to make sure lessons are running while you're here.

Staying here

  • Check-in 14:00–19:00 | check-out 06:00–11:00
  • Air conditioning, a private bathroom and a private entrance in every room
  • Adults only. No pets, no smoking, no extra beds. Cash only. Quiet from 23:00 to 06:00. Bring photo ID and a credit card for check-in.

Baba's Surf Shop

There are 400 boards for rent, in different sizes, tails and colours.

If your own board gets damaged, the shaper here can fix it fast.

On the shelves there's beachwear, straps, bags and, of course, wax. It's a shop run by surfers, for surfers.

  • Surfboards Shortboards, longboards and fish
  • Cheeky Monkey boards Our own brand, shaped in Bali
  • Scooters

Brands: Cheeky Monkey | Creatures of Leisure | Shapers

Message us on Instagram

Up on the roof

The house looks out on a 180° sea view. One guest wrote that "the ocean view is amazing from the rooftop".

Yoga happens up there too, at sunrise and at sunset, facing the ocean.

Air conditioning in every room | Private bathroom in every room | Private entrance to every room | Surf shop on site | Gym | Rooftop bar with a pool table | Yoga on the rooftop | Sun terrace | Free WiFi (57 Mbps) | Free private parking (reservation needed) | Airport shuttle (additional charge) | Laundry | Daily housekeeping | Luggage storage | Currency exchange | CCTV in common areas and outside

Three rooms in 2009

Cheeky Monkey opened in late 2009 as a small guesthouse with three rooms, a tiny surf shop and a restaurant. By 2021 it had ten rooms.

Baba founded it. Like most kids in the area, he taught himself to surf at twelve. He worked as a surf instructor too, and the shop carries his name.

Getting here

Cheeky Monkey is on the Galle–Matara main road. Booking.com puts Midigama Beach 350 m away and Midigama train station 800 m, then Ahangama Beach at 2 km, Weligama Beach at 3.3 km and Koggala Airport at 10 km.

Galle - Matara Main Road, Midigama East Midigama, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka

Airport drop USD 65 | Airport pick-up USD 65 | Drop and pick-up USD 130 | published 2021
